messages:
maria: Quick ping — PR #41876 needs runtime + infra + security eyes before the canary window tomorrow morning. It's a small routing + eviction tweak that changes how we prioritize KV spillbacks. @lin @aj @samir @sofia can you spare a quick look? link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/41876 

lin: I can take a look this afternoon. Can you paste a 2-line summary and any perf numbers? :eyes:

maria: Sure — summary: prefer local GPU pools for short-lived requests, lower eviction aggressiveness for pinned KV ranges, fallback routing to warm variants sooner. Perf: p50 latency ~+3ms, p95 ~+8ms on our worst-case microbench, throughput unchanged. Added a unit test for eviction heuristics. Patch snippet:
```
diff --git a/runtime/eviction.go b/runtime/eviction.go
+ // reduce eviction score for pinned kv ranges
+ score = score * 0.6
```

aj: I'll take runtime review. Two asks: 1) add a changelog entry (brief) so SOC can triage, 2) confirm no behavioral change for dedicated capacity customers (we should gate via flag). I'll add inline comments later.

samir: Eng-infra: can review the bpf/memory interaction. Quick Q: does this require new kernel caps or sysctl tuning? If so we need rollout steps & fallback.

maria: No new caps. We added a config boolean `eviction.new_policy` default false; plan is: canary with flag=true on 10% of traffic in canary region, monitor KV miss/backpressure for 2 hours, then ramp. I'll add a rollout checklist to the PR description.

sofia: Eng-security: I can eyeball for data-exposure concerns tonight. If the change touches any telemetry we need to ensure no PII. From the summary looks fine.

ops-bot: merge-queue-bot: PR #41876 added to canary queue (owner: maria). Note: merge window is 05:30 PT.

maria: Thanks — will wait for @lin, @aj, @samir, @sofia comments. If no blockers by 05:25 PT I'll flip the feature flag for the canary and proceed. :thumbsup:

lin: left two tiny nits inline, nothing blocking.

aj: left runtime comment about the test harness; will LGTM once addressed. :white_check_mark:

samir: added one infra note about monitoring alert thresholds, not blocking.

maria: addressed comments, updated PR description with rollout checklist and monitoring playbook. Ping again for final thumbs.

sofia: security OK, no PII risk detected.

aj: LGTM.

maria: Awesome — scheduling the 10% canary at 05:30 PT. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
